name: ARC-400 Three-Phase MMA Welder 320A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-400 three-phase MMA welding machine

summary: 320A three-phase stick welder at 80% duty — the entry to the heavy fabrication class.
description: The ARC-400 moves into the three-phase heavy class: 320A rated current at 80% duty cycle, 2.5–5.0 mm rod range and a ferrite-core T102 transformer driven by two G50N120 IGBTs. This is the baseline machine for steel structure plants that run long, continuous seams.
